zh.title: 航空安全彙整：Western Global飛機在東京滑出跑道等4起獨立事件
zh.summary: Western Global飛機在東京滑出跑道；另有3起獨立航空事件
body: The Aviation Herald報導4起彼此獨立的航空事件，現有資訊未指出事件間有關聯。
1. Western Global的波音747-400（ICAO機型代碼B744）於2026年11月25日在東京反向滑行時滑出跑道。
2. American的波音787-8（ICAO機型代碼B788）於2026年11月24日在阿姆斯特丹發生輪胎洩氣事件。
3. Wizz的空中巴士A321neo（ICAO機型代碼A21N）於2026年11月23日在巴塞隆納附近發生引擎問題。
4. UPS的波音757-200（ICAO機型代碼B752）於2026年11月23日在安大略發生飛行中引擎關閉事件。

en.title: Safety roundup: Four independent incidents include Western Global's Tokyo runway excursion
en.summary: Western Global aircraft had a runway excursion in Tokyo; three other independent aviation incidents were reported.
body: The Aviation Herald reported four independent aviation incidents. No connection between them was stated.
1. Western Global's Boeing 747-400 (ICAO type code B744) had a runway excursion while backtracking at Tokyo on November 25, 2026.
2. An American Boeing 787-8 (ICAO type code B788) had a flat tyre at Amsterdam on November 24, 2026.
3. A Wizz Airbus A321neo (ICAO type code A21N) had an engine problem near Barcelona on November 23, 2026.
4. A UPS Boeing 757-200 (ICAO type code B752) experienced an engine shutdown in flight at Ontario on November 23, 2026.
